Recorded claim:
Codex app-server and current Playwright integrations do not automatically control Electron-embedded pages. AI control needs an explicit MCP/dynamic-tool bridge; dynamic tools are experimental and absent here. Keep existing Playwright Phabricator automation, with its separate `~/.tb-tools/phabricator-browser` profile, until a replacement is proven. [Task 1]
